scene: You roll into Glass Aquarium Hall. Giant glowing tanks hum.
picture: A flat side view of a tiled hall. Far left, an open glass elevator sits with illuminated doors. Left, a sleepy octopus naps in a wide tank. Centre, the player sits in her purple wheelchair beside a glowing jellyfish cylinder. Right, a yellow food dispenser stands beside a submerged archway leading far right.
shown: a huge sleepy octopus curled inside a glass tank on the left
a glowing cylinder filled with pink jellyfish in the centre
a bright yellow fish food dispenser standing on the right
